media.alt_text:
Prepare for Extreme Heat
- Keep pets inside
- Drink plenty of water
- Keep generators outside
- Listen to local officials
- Limit strenuous activity
- Stay in air-conditioned area
- Wear light, loose-fitting clothing
- Do not leave people or pets in closed cars
- Check in on seniors and those vulnerable to the heat
- Stay informed by visiting Heat.gov and downloading the FEMA App
- Locate your local cooling center at 211.org in case you lose power
- Prepare your home by covering windows with drapes or shades, adding insulation to keep heat out, installing air condition
